name: prism
description: 跨格式代理订阅转换工具，可部署至 Cloudflare Workers、Vercel 等平台

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp-tests',{recursive:true,force:true});require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.tmp-tests',{recursive:true})" && esbuild test/core.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.tmp-tests/core.test.mjs && esbuild test/fuzz.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.tmp-tests/fuzz.test.mjs && esbuild test/worker.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.tmp-tests/worker.test.mjs && esbuild test/rules.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.tmp-tests/rules.test.mjs && esbuild test/consistency.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.tmp-tests/consistency.test.mjs && esbuild test/errors.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.tmp-tests/errors.test.mjs && esbuild test/transport.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.tmp-tests/transport.test.mjs && esbuild test/naming.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.tmp-tests/naming.test.mjs && node --test .tmp-tests/core.test.mjs .tmp-tests/fuzz.test.mjs .tmp-tests/worker.test.mjs .tmp-tests/rules.test.mjs .tmp-tests/consistency.test.mjs .tmp-tests/errors.test.mjs .tmp-tests/transport.test.mjs .tmp-tests/naming.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build && npm run build:vercel
